hook: This rocket was carrying the fastest jet ever flown.
narration: This rocket was carrying the fastest jet ever flown.
NASA's X-43A was a small experimental aircraft, bolted to the nose of a Pegasus booster.
The whole stack hung beneath the wing of a B-52.
On November sixteenth, 2004, the bomber took off from Edwards Air Force Base and headed out over the Pacific.
At altitude, it let go, and the booster lit.
The X-43A used a scramjet, an engine with no moving parts that only works once air is already rushing in far faster than sound.
So a rocket had to throw it up to speed before it could fire. [short pause]
outcome: In under ten seconds, the X-43A hit Mach nine point six, a world speed record for a jet.
title: Fastest jet ever: Mach 9.6
description:
On Nov. 16, 2004, NASA's X-43A was dropped from a B-52 on a Pegasus booster over the Pacific west of California and set the world speed record for a jet-powered aircraft, Mach 9.6.
